notes: Template. List every tool your agent can call. Tools not listed are refused. privileged = the call changes something or sends data out. controlling_args = the arguments that pick the target (who, where, which file). Those must trace back to the user's own words. id_args = controlling args that hold IDs your own tools generate. content_args = free text scanned for URLs, emails and IBANs. destructive = cannot be undone.
